notes.title: Update 1.1.0: Featuring Controller Support!
notes.notes:
We wanted to get this update out there before our release on the 9th, and we did it! [b]The majority of the game has been tweaked to allow for controller support![/b]

You can now navigate through the puzzles and gallery as well as completing puzzles entirely with your controller! Some aspects still need the use of a mouse, like popping sloths and some less frequent menu items.
